meta.prompt: Help me schedule a 30 minute meeting with three colleagues (Priya, Marcus and Elena) next week. Let me pick a day (Mon 16, Tue 17, Wed 18, Thu 19, Fri 20 Nov), then one of that day's time slots: 09:00, 10:00, 11:00, 13:00, 14:00 or 15:00, where some are taken: Mon 10:00 and 13:00; Tue 09:00 and 14:00; Wed 11:00 and 15:00; Thu 09:00, 10:00 and 13:00; Fri 11:00 and 14:00. Show who is attending and a confirm button. After confirming the card says the meeting is booked, with the day and the time it runs from and to (for example Wed 18 Nov, 14:00 to 14:30).
meta.text:
ChatCard "Schedule a meeting" "30 minutes with Priya, Marcus and Elena" icon:"event_rounded" status:"Next week" w:390
  state day=""
  state slot=""
  state booked=false
  let taken = {"Mon 16":["10:00","13:00"],"Tue 17":["09:00","14:00"],"Wed 18":["11:00","15:00"],"Thu 19":["09:00","10:00","13:00"],"Fri 20":["11:00","14:00"]}
  if !booked
    SectionLabel "Day" "Nov"
    DayPicker =day days:["Mon 16","Tue 17","Wed 18","Thu 19","Fri 20"] -> slot=""
    if day!=""
      SectionLabel "Time" "30 min"
      ChoiceChips =slot options:["09:00","10:00","11:00","13:00","14:00","15:00"] disabled:=coalesce(taken[day],[])
    SectionLabel "Attendees" "3"
    Details rows:[["Priya","Required"],["Marcus","Required"],["Elena","Required"]]
    ActionButton "Confirm" primary icon:"check_rounded" enabled:{day!="" and slot!=""} -> booked=true
  if booked
    Receipt "Meeting booked" "Priya, Marcus and Elena have been invited." code:="{day} Nov, {slot} to {slot}" tone:good icon:"event_available_rounded"
